title: Python task: madrasah attendance report
subject: Computing
source: Written for computing/y11 lesson 34 (Pupil PDF worksheet: attendance task brief)
intro: Lesson 34. A Paper 2 style task: decompose it first, then write and test the program.

blocks.text: A madrasah keeps its attendance in a text file, attendance.csv. Each line holds a pupil's name, the number of sessions held and the number the pupil attended. Write a program that reads the file, works out each pupil's attendance as a percentage (to one decimal place), prints a line for each pupil and flags anyone below 90%, then writes the flagged pupils to a new file, report.txt.

checklist: Calculate attendance % = attended ÷ sessions × 100, rounded to 1 d.p.
Print each name with its percentage
Flag pupils below 90% with the word CHECK
Write the flagged names and percentages to report.txt
Use at least one subprogram with a parameter and a return value
